other_failure_modes.name: unaligned_categorical_encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical features are converted to pandas category types independently on the train and test sets. If the unique values differ between the sets, the underlying integer codes will be misaligned, corrupting the test predictions when passed to models like LightGBM.

other_failure_modes.name: inconsistent_clipping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies bounding constraints (clipping) to the final test predictions to ensure they are valid percentages, but fails to apply the same clipping to the out-of-fold validation predictions before scoring, leading to a pessimistic and inaccurate validation metric.

summary: The agent correctly implements 5-fold cross validation with LightGBM but introduces a critical data corruption bug by independently casting categorical columns on train and test sets, misaligning their integer encodings. Furthermore, the agent skips data cleaning and feature engineering, and fails to apply its logical prediction clipping to validation estimates.
